title: BJSS is kept as a warning, not a target: acquisition converted it to CGI's stack
content:
BJSS was the UK's largest independent engineering consultancy and has been acquired; its stack is now CGI's. The record keeps it as a warning rather than as a target, because the independence that qualified it is gone and the technology direction is now set by the acquirer.

The detail that makes it a warning rather than simply a deletion is that it won a GBP 27.8m NHS Education for Scotland contract after the deal. Acquisition did not cost it the public-sector business; it cost this lead set an independent supplier. The pattern that follows is commercially relevant: the largest independent firms in these markets are the ones being bought, so a lead qualified on independence has a shelf life, and the independence field needs a date attached to it.

It sits at priority 9, do not pitch.
